entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-09
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `dotnet-format` messes up comma placement in switch expression with empty return #85982
  • Roslyn fails to process user defined conversions for union constructor arguments nullability analysis #85978

Closed

  • Syntax node actions run more than once for union declarations and their members #85974

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/insiders] Fix analyzer collision in bootstrap leg (backport #85870) #85987
  • Ensure unused BoundPassByCopy access evaluates all observable side effects #85986
    Area-Compilers
  • Bound test runner output draining after process exit #85985
  • Fix ParentTag binding for Tag Helpers inside plain HTML elements #85981
    Community, Area-Razor
  • Unsafe evolution: add csc flag and msbuild property #85980
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Add src/ExpressionEvaluator to CODEOWNERS #85977
  • Keep tuple element names when nullable analysis re-infers a call with a tuple literal argument #85976
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Don't include the zero member when formatting a flags enum TypedConstant #85975
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Observe side effects of accessing an array element used as the receiver of an implicit indexer in the right order #85973
    Area-Compilers

Merged

  • Fix project data IVT #85959
    Next
  • Don't ship PDBs or XML doc comment files in our tool package #85983
    Next
  • Mirror ProjectData 70a56b30: reader, generator, and build-task projects #85984
    Next
  • Bound local test partitions and collect hang dumps across platforms #85849
    Next
  • Unsafe evolution: improve PublicApiAnalyzer tests #85979
    Area-IDE, Feature - Unsafe Evolution, Next
  • Unsafe evolution: use C# 15 in LangVersion tests #85964
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution, Next
  • Unsafe evolution: unify requires-unsafe terminology #85961
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution, Next
  • Ensure unused field value access evaluates all observable side effects #85962
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Ref Locals and Returns, Next
  • Fix race between FBP loader and LSP both opening a document #85942
    VSCode, Next
  • Reuse our existing file watching consolidation logic for LSP #85951
    VSCode, Next

Updated

  • Fix symbol-completion publication races #85972
  • Implement OnDemand Project Loading #85805
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Add predicate version of IOperation.Descendants and DescendantsAndSelf #85898
    Area-Compilers, Community, Needs API Review
  • Split local and Helix test runners #85859
  • Migrate tests to xUnit v3 #85776
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Handle ref field dereference failures without aborting expansion #85967
    Area-IDE, Community
  • Also filter out methods hidden by non-browsable methods in completion #85968
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Fix compilation caching across filtered generator runs #85935
    Area-Compilers, Community, Feature - Source Generators
  • Onboard build failure analysis workflow #85046
    Area-Infrastructure, Community
  • Introduce a Razor DLL for `dotnet format`, and share formatting code #85963
    Needs API Review, Area-Razor
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #85945
  • [release/dev18.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #85960
